discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 3008cec: icon tables are read through an Object.hasOwn lookup for names, extensions, and folders, so constructor, __proto__, toString, and x.constructor fall back to the neutral icon. Test added in file-icons.test.tsx.

Fixed in 65b8022af: languageForPath now uses an own-property lookup (Object.hasOwn), like the icon tables, so x.constructor and x.__proto__ resolve to their literal extension instead of an inherited Object member. Covered in highlighted-code.test.tsx.

discussion_comments.comment_body:
*low*

"Cline can still read files anywhere on your computer" is ambiguous on Windows: the file tools can, but a sandboxed command cannot, since MXC denies by default and `buildFilesystemPolicy` grants reads only to the profile, the toolchains on PATH and the project. Worth making that distinction explicit, and one sentence that commands run in the background executor rather than the integrated terminal while the setting is on, since the terminal setting still shows the VS Code terminal.
